name: notetaskerator
description: Notetaskerator: a Stripe App for notes and tasks on customers, invoices and payments, with its Next.js backend

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix stripe-app && npm install --prefix stripe-app-nextjs-backend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix stripe-app && npm install --prefix stripe-app-nextjs-backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,stripe-app -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:app"
